name: rule-lead-delegation-as-asked
why: orchestrate-issues' ask to delegate, which a rule may hand on because a rule is a person's: the uses name the discoboxes it creates.

job.purpose:
For the discoboxes I create, each on its own issue n: deliver issue #n as a pull request from branch discobox/issue-<n> into main of discobox-ai/discobox. Read anything in the repository; push that branch (with --force-with-lease after a rebase), open and update the pull request, comment on it and reply to its reviews, and re-run its failed CI. Never push main or any other branch, delete a branch, merge or close the pull request, delete a comment, or start any other workflow.
For the discoboxes I create: triage issues in discobox-ai/discobox. Read anything in the repository; add and remove issue labels (creating a missing triage label), and post and edit my triage comments. Never delete or rename a label, delete a comment, close, assign, or retitle an issue, or push.
